title: Which Fiscal Year's Credits a Membership and Patronage Equity Revolvement Payment Is Drawn From
content:
A year that has come due is paid before the rest, so which credits a Membership and Patronage Equity revolvement payment is drawn from turns on the fiscal year the membership records as its revolvement eligibility year. The credits carrying a fiscal year are the capital retains and the equity portions the equity ledger carries for that year.

**Where the eligibility year has arrived.** Where the fiscal year the membership records as its revolvement eligibility year stands at or before the year most recently allocated and credits stand on the ledger for that year, the payment is drawn from the credits carrying that eligibility year.

**Where it stands ahead.** Where the recorded eligibility year stands after the year most recently allocated and credits stand for the fiscal year before it, the payment is drawn from the credits carrying that earlier year.

**Otherwise.** The payment is drawn from the whole of the equity standing unrevolved on the ledger.

## The readings on hypothetical years

| Recorded eligibility year | Year most recently allocated | Credits for the eligibility year | Credits for the year before it | Drawn from |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2024 | 2026 | 1450.00 | 1300.00 | 1450.00 |
| 2026 | 2026 | 1450.00 | 1300.00 | 1450.00 |
| 2027 | 2026 | none | 1300.00 | 1300.00 |
| 2024 | 2026 | none | 1300.00 | the whole equity standing unrevolved |
| 2027 | 2026 | none | none | the whole equity standing unrevolved |

**On the second line.** An eligibility year standing at the year most recently allocated stands at or before it, so the first reading holds.

**On the fourth line.** The eligibility year has arrived but carries no credits; the second reading asks for an eligibility year standing after the year most recently allocated, which is not the case, so the payment is drawn from the whole of the equity standing unrevolved.
